item.title: Former CNN host Don Lemon pleads not guilty to charges in Minnesota church protest
item.description: Former CNN host turned independent journalist Don Lemon pleaded not guilty to federal civil rights charges Friday, following a protest at a Minnesota church where an Immigration and Customs Enforcement official is a pastor. Four others are set to be arraigned in the case.

item.title: Lindsey Vonn still needs multiple surgeries after Olympics crash, she says: 'A hard few days'
item.description: Olympic skier Lindsey Vonn is scheduled to undergo yet another surgery — and another after that — to fix the broken tibia she sustained when she crashed.

item.title: Weather Channel star Jim Cantore named grand marshal of Baton Rouge St. Patrick's parade
item.description: The grand marshal for this year's Wearin' of the Green Parade will be coming to Baton Rouge for a good reason this time.

item.title: LABI announces Scott Ballard as 2026 board chairman
item.description: The Louisiana Association of Business and Industry (LABI) has announced its 2026 Board of Directors, with Scott Ballard serving as the Board Chairman and the Emerging Leaders Council featuring young professionals with a range of backgrounds and expertise.

item.title: Ring ends partnership with surveillance firm after Super Bowl ad backlash
item.description: Amazon’s doorbell product Ring announced it is ending its partnership with a surveillance firm after a controversial Super Bowl ad sparked privacy concerns.

item.title: Louisiana Public Service Commissioner Eric Skrmetta drops US Senate bid, backs Julia Letlow
item.description: Louisiana Public Service Commissioner Eric Skrmetta announced he would not be qualifying for the U.S. Senate race and endorsed Congresswoman Julia Letlow.

item.title: Artists can submit proposals for memorial to honor French Quarter terrorist attack victims
item.description: Artists are invited to submit proposals for a permanent memorial in honor of the French Quarter terrorist attack victims.

item.title: Zachary man to serve 14 years in prison for having over 1,300 files of child porn
item.description: A Zachary man was sentenced to 175 months after pleading guilty to possession of child pornography.

item.title: Woman’s Hospital launches 'Mammograms Mambo' campaign, promoting yearly breast cancer screenings
item.description: Woman’s Hospital is kicking off its “Mammograms Mambo” campaign, urging women across the Capital Region to make breast cancer screening a yearly priority.
